# Zynth - 3D Music Sequencer

A modern, interactive 3D music sequencer built with React and Three.js. This project combines WebGL visualization with Web Audio API for a unique music creation experience.

### Project-Specific Guidance

#### Audio & Synthesis
- This project uses **Tone.js** for audio synthesis with multiple synth types (AM, FM, Membrane, Metal)
- Five instruments with individual effects chains (reverb, filter, distortion, attack, intonation)
- Musical modes include Chromatic, Ionian, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian, Locrian, and Octatonic
- Audio context state management is critical for browser autoplay policies

#### 3D Visualization
- Uses **@react-three/fiber** for declarative Three.js in React
- **@react-three/drei** provides utilities (OrbitControls, useCursor)
- 16x16x16 3D grid sequencer with real-time playback visualization
- Custom lighting and shadow system for cube rendering

#### Component Architecture
- Main App component manages global state (BPM, instruments, effects, grid)
- Memoized components (PianoKey, FrontCube) for performance
- Refs used for audio objects and real-time state synchronization
- Keyboard controls with Tab-toggle piano mapping

#### Styling Approach
- Custom CSS with CSS variables for theming
- Gradient-based color system for instruments
- No CSS framework; hand-crafted utility-first styles
- Dark theme with neon accents (cyan, blue, purple gradients)

### Testing Strategy

- Unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library
- Component tests should verify user interactions (keyboard, grid clicks)
- Audio tests require mocking Tone.js and Web Audio API
- Test command: `npm test`

### Build & Development

- Start dev server: `npm start`
- Build for production: `npm run build`
- Run tests: `npm test`
- No eject performed (using default CRA configuration)
